# TutorCourt

TutorCourt is a Nigerian online tutoring marketplace connecting K-12 students and parents with vetted, expert tutors.

## About
- Founded in Nigeria; primarily serves Nigerian students (K-12, WAEC, JAMB, Common Entrance)
- All tutors undergo identity verification and background checks
- Payments are escrow-protected in Naira (NGN)
- Supports both one-on-one and group tutoring sessions (online and hybrid)

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://www.tutorcourt.com
- Find tutors: https://www.tutorcourt.com/search
- Browse subjects: https://www.tutorcourt.com/subjects
- For parents: https://www.tutorcourt.com/for-parents
- For tutors: https://www.tutorcourt.com/for-tutors

## How it works
1. Parents or students browse and filter tutors by subject, grade level, price, and rating
2. Book a free introductory session
3. Pay via escrow — funds are held until the session is complete
4. Rate and review the tutor after each session
